verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes an OpenAPI spec for its Cloud API at cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json, describing REST endpoints for managing resources, and its docs point to API-based instance launch, so a machine-readable API reference exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive (try-it console) or includes runnable examples, and probes for an OpenAPI spec at standard paths on docs.lambda.ai returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer or try-it console, runnable request examples, discoverable spec on the docs site, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
